_comment: Extra product uuids that are the SAME product as a mapped website slug, per environment. products.config.ts maps one platform uuid per website slug, but each environment's products table carries duplicate rows for some products — a second enabled row with the same sku and the same price that the config map does not point at (e.g. the older 'Compounded Tirzepatide' alongside the newer 'Compounded Tirzepatide - 3 month'). Left alone, those duplicates render an empty product page. Both SQL generators (content and compare-at) treat each uuid here as an additional target for its slug's content/anchor, so both rows get the same result. Only genuine duplicates are listed — verified same sku AND same price as the mapped product, and currently without pdp. Deliberately excluded: dev's 'Semaglutide Plan'/'Tirzepatide Plan' (sku sema-plan-3month / tirz-plan-3months) — different skus and one different price ($599), i.e. scratch/test products, not duplicates. Verified against each environment's DB on 2026-07-15. To refresh: list products per env, find enabled rows sharing a mapped product's sku+price but missing metadata.pdp, and add their uuid under the matching website slug.
